QF.id: SIA Assessment Frameworks Techniques and Standards_44

question.text: Jeevan Jyoti Foundation runs a maternal-health program. When selecting SAS standards, the SIA should start with SAS-100 (engagement-level), then overlay:

answer.text: Sector-specific SAS standards (e.g., SAS-200 series for healthcare) to pick domain-appropriate indicators
Only the Companies Act 2013 Section 135 CSR rules
Only the SEBI ICDR Regulation 292B eligible-activities list

explanation.text: The Logic: Engagement methodology flows from SAS-100 (umbrella) down to SAS-200 and higher sector standards that contain domain-specific indicators. For maternal health, SAS-200 healthcare indicators apply. CSR, ICDR and 80G are ancillary regulatory references, not the primary indicator source. The Trap: CSR/ICDR/80G govern eligibility and tax but don't give you outcome indicators. Only SAS sector standards do. Cross-Exam Context: III-A / III-C Compliance reference multiple standards boards; XXIII uses SAS-100 + SAS-2xx / 4xx / 5xx / 11xx / 13xx architecture. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Cross-reference the SAS indicator IDs with IRIS+ and SDG targets in an AIR appendix — it maximises usefulness for both domestic (SAS) and international (IRIS+, SDG) audiences in one document.
